title: Checkpoint
description: Immutable snapshot of an execution run's resumable state. A checkpoint can resume the producing run or initialize a forked run.

metadata.description: Optional non-authoritative storage or producer metadata; it is not included in state_digest unless explicitly part of covered state.

checkpoint_id.description: Stable snapshot identifier: ckpt- followed by the lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of (parent_run_id, state_digest, nonce).

parent_run_id.description: Opaque non-empty identifier in the same namespace as aep-record.run_id for the run that produced this checkpoint.

state_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical UTF-8 JSON representation of the complete resumable state, encoded as sha256:<lowercase-hex>.

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the checkpoint was captured.

fork_reference.description: Source checkpoint_id for derived state, or null. Omitted on an ordinary checkpoint.
